question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Callous
solution:
The correct answer is **"Insensitive."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Callous"** means showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others. (दूसरों की भावनाओं या पीड़ा की उपेक्षा करते हुए; कठोर हृदय, बेदर्द, निष्ठुर, संवेदनाहीन)

 
 
• **Example**: *The **callous**__ remarks of the politician angered the public.*
 
 
 
• *​**"*****Insensitive"** is a synonym of **"callous."**
 
• It means lacking in feeling or consideration for others. (दूसरों की भावनाओं की उपेक्षा करने वाला और इस प्रकार उन्‍हें कष्‍ट पहुँचाने वाला; संवेदनाहीन)
 __
 
• **Example**: *She is very **insensitive**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Inordinate** means excessive or unreasonable. (सामान्‍य या प्रत्‍याशित से बहुत अधिक, अत्‍यधिक; अमर्यादित)
 
• **Compassionate** means showing sympathy and concern for others. (दूसरों के प्रति सहानुभूति और चिंता दिखाना)
 
• **Unshackle** means to release from restraints or restrictions. (बंधनों या प्रतिबंधों से मुक्त होना)
